title: Green Account (savings): Why is paperless required?
summary: This document explains that the Green Account (savings) requires paperless statements (paperless delivery: Yes) and describes how monthly environmental impact reports are delivered digitally. It also notes that paperless complements a debit card made from recycled ocean plastic and gives steps to verify paperless status in online/mobile banking.
